text_block_list.text: Just as Air Groove and I returned from our outing, we bumped into Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Suzuka.
Training starting now?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, I just thought I'd go for a light run
to clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're always running, aren't you?
Well, I suppose that's just who you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, care to run together if you'd like?
I happen to be in the mood for a light jog myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Quite the opposite.
It is precisely because I am refreshed that I wish to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So, how about you, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, as long as I can run... either is fine with me.

And so,
the two dashed off at the same time, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... gah!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo... Haaah!!
The two scored their goals almost simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sharp running, as usual.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Even when Air Groove ran...
she was completely serious halfway through, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because you're going all out.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Because I don't want to lose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well then, how about another match?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
This time, I'm going all out right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's the same on my end.
I have no intention of holding back.
choice_data_list: Don't overdo it, both of you...
Don't overdo it, both of you...
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's the same on my end.
I have no intention of holding back.
choice_data_list: Don't overdo it, both of you...
Don't overdo it, both of you...
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!
Air Groove, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know!
In moderation, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, within reason...
Air Groove, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah, anytime is fine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now—

Afterward, they ran the course many times
to settle the score, but on this day,
the match remained undecided.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you yelling about...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"This is merely training.
Such cheering is unnecessary."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that nice?
I'm a little jealous.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Agh.
What are you doing? Hurry up and run!

Afterward, the two of them raced several times,
but on this day, no victor
could be decided.
